-- Alfred Ghostty Super+T Workflow property open_new : "n" -- Force new window property reuse_tab : false property timeout_seconds : 3 property shell_load_delay : 1.0 property switch_delay : 0.35
on isRunning() application "Ghostty" is running end isRunning
on summon() tell application "Ghostty" to activate end summon
on hasWindows() if not isRunning() then return false tell application "System Events" return exists window 1 of process "Ghostty" end tell end hasWindows
on waitForWindow(timeout_s) set end_time to (current date) + timeout_s repeat until hasWindows() or ((current date) > end_time) delay 0.05 end repeat return hasWindows() end waitForWindow
on handleWindow(just_activated) if just_activated then return end if set has_windows to hasWindows() set needs_window to not has_windows tell application "System Events" if needs_window then keystroke "n" using command down -- New window return end if keystroke "n" using command down -- New window end tell end handleWindow
on run argv set just_activated to not isRunning() summon() if just_activated then if not waitForWindow(timeout_seconds) then display dialog "Failed to create initial window" return end if end if handleWindow(just_activated) end run
